fix_code:
N, M = map(int, input().split())
H = list(map(int, input().split()))

remaining_disinfectant = M
aliens_disinfected = 0

for i in range(N):
    if remaining_disinfectant >= H[i]:
        remaining_disinfectant -= H[i]
        aliens_disinfected += 1
    else:
        break

print(aliens_disinfected)
